decisionEvidencePolicy: All decisions cite the DOI-matched metadata/abstract available in compact blob 9de05665f88100a34d882045eca97440b2d09080. decisions.title: Mechanical Programming of Hollow DNA Nanocapsules Rewires In Vivo Trafficking
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract and Wiley Early View description identify stiffness-programmed DNA nanocapsules, protein-corona remodeling, biodistribution and antisense delivery as the contribution. Chemical identity is held constant while capsule mechanics are changed.
decisions.challengeReason: Considered whether interfacial assembly establishes an in-scope polymer-synthesis method. The described advance is nanocapsule fabrication and biological trafficking, not a new covalent polymerization, monomer scope or preparative organic transformation.

decisions.title: Ratiometric Luminescent Thermo-Hygrometry, Metal-Dependent Second Harmonic Generation, and Humidity-Variable Magnetic Relaxation in a Manganese(II)-Doped Zinc(II) Molecular Halide
decisions.evidenceBasis: Compact abstract and Wiley description concern Mn doping of a Zn molecular halide and coupled luminescence, humidity sensing, nonlinear optical and magnetic properties. The prepared objects are multifunctional coordination materials.
decisions.challengeReason: Actively tested the synthetic-strategy wording: it describes assembly/doping of a sensor material, not a general organic reaction or polymerization methodology. Organic ligands alone do not establish the required preparative organic scope.

decisions.title: Unlocking the Catalytic Potential of PFAS: Upcycling Forever Chemicals Into Effective Catalysts
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract and publisher listing describe conversion of PFAS-containing wastewater into fluorinated heterogeneous catalyst materials, demonstrated in PET methanolysis/hydrolysis and recycling of 23 real-world plastic-waste samples.
decisions.challengeReason: Considered ester cleavage and monomer recovery as preparative chemistry. The affirmative scope shown is pollutant-derived catalyst fabrication and PET-waste recycling, not a general diverse-organic-substrate synthetic method or a new polymerization/chain-control strategy. Different waste specimens do not by themselves establish such a method. Exclusion is not based merely on the presence of a polymer.

decisions.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
decisions.evidenceBasis: The complete compact record supplies a title, DOI, authors and date but an empty abstract. The title permits both preparative paired electrosynthesis and an energy/electrocatalysis interpretation. Direct publisher DOI, abstract and full-text landing-page probes yielded no usable article text; exact DOI/title searches supplied no matching affirmative scope evidence.
decisions.challengeReason: Tried to falsify both possible final outcomes. CO2 reduction does not prove an energy-only contribution, and alcohol oxidation does not prove general preparative substrate scope. Neither include nor exclude can presently be defended. Both current passes agree to retain an evidence-gap pending; the inherited exclusion is withdrawn from staging.
decisions.evidenceNeeded: Publisher abstract or accessible article text identifying products, alcohol/substrate scope, preparative utility and whether the central contribution is organic synthesis versus energy/material electrocatalysis.

decisions.title: Bidirectional Alkene-Nucleophile Coupling at a Single Carbon Center Enabled by a Methylene-Bridged Thianthrenium Dication
decisions.evidenceBasis: The compact abstract describes a methylene-bridged thianthrenium reagent enabling sequential alkene hydroalkylation and nucleophile incorporation. Multiple N, O, B, S, Se, C and halide nucleophile classes establish a modular preparative coupling scope.
decisions.challengeReason: Tested whether this is only reagent-property characterization or a medicinal application. The central demonstrated advance is general bond construction across a methylene unit, with divergent reaction manifolds and broad partner classes; drug examples are downstream utility.

decisions.title: Disentangling Electronic and Lattice Contributions to Transient Absorption in Metal Halide Perovskites: A First-Principles Study of CH3NH3PbBr3
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract develops nonequilibrium Bethe-Salpeter calculations and molecular dynamics to interpret electronic and lattice contributions to transient absorption in a metal-halide perovskite.
decisions.challengeReason: No preparative organic reaction is presented in the available abstract; the described advance is computational spectroscopy of an inorganic/hybrid material, not synthetic methodology.

decisions.title: Enantioselective Defluorinative C(sp2)-H Allylation of Acrylamides Enabled by CpxRh(III) Catalysis
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports asymmetric acrylamide C(sp2)-H functionalization with allylic difluorides to diverse enantioenriched fluorinated 1,4-dienes and divergent chiral piperidone synthesis, with explicit substrate diversity and stereocontrol.
decisions.challengeReason: The outcome is a general catalytic bond-forming protocol, not merely synthesis of one functional molecule, mechanistic analysis or biological testing. Broad coupling scope and divergent preparative utility confirm inclusion.

decisions.title: EZSolver: Template-Free Prediction of Polar Enzymatic Mechanisms via Bidirectional Flow Matching and Search
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract describes a generative flow-matching and beam-search model evaluated on prediction accuracy and chemical plausibility for enzymatic mechanisms. Its reported achievements are computational prediction and out-of-distribution inference.
decisions.challengeReason: Actively considered the biocatalyst-design claim. Future enzyme discovery is a proposed application; the abstract does not report a new experimental preparative biocatalytic transformation with synthetic substrate scope. A mechanism-prediction method alone is outside this Gallery's preparative-method scope.

decisions.title: Functional Group Transpositional Trimolecular Cross-Coupling via Interrupted Homolytic Substitution
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports nickel/photoredox trimolecular coupling of allylamines through interrupted homolytic substitution, amino migration and radical sorting, furnishing over 60 varied alkylamines with functional-group tolerance and regioselectivity.
decisions.challengeReason: Drug-discovery motivation does not control scope: the core result is a demonstrated general three-component synthetic transformation, not a biomedical assay or purely proposed mechanism. Diverse radical partners and product scope support inclusion.

decisions.title: Non-Canonical Peptide Self-Assembly for Mitochondria-Specific Cargo Delivery
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract identifies a tetrapeptide self-assembly platform and chlorambucil conjugate for mitochondrial delivery, tumor-cell selectivity, immune modulation and antitumor effects.
decisions.challengeReason: Considered the noncanonical peptide chemistry and conjugation. They enable a biomedical delivery study rather than establish a general peptide-bond-forming, organic-synthetic or polymerization method; self-assembly is not itself proof of such a method.

decisions.title: Isoindole-Based Multicomponent Synthesis of Pyrimido[6,1,2-cd]pyrrolizine Fluorophores with Unsymmetrical Urea Handles: Photophysical, Theoretical, and Antifungal Imaging Studies
decisions.evidenceBasis: The available abstract affirmatively describes diversity-oriented one-pot multicomponent construction of a library of unsymmetrical-urea PP heterocycles from accessible precursors, with side-chain diversification. Imaging and photophysics follow this preparative route.
decisions.challengeReason: Actively tested the application-heavy title against the materials/biomedical exclusion. The library-forming multicomponent strategy and structural diversification provide affirmative synthetic-method scope beyond a single probe fabrication. The 2026-09-22 publication meets JOC's activation date.
decisions.evidenceLimitation: Abstract-level review; direct ACS article access was unavailable. No full-text or scheme inspection is claimed.

decisions.title: K2S-Mediated Tandem Selenylation and Cyclization of CaC2 with Diselenides: Synthesis of 2-Methylbenzoselenazole
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports a one-step diselenide/calcium-carbide selenylation-cyclization strategy mediated by K2S for benzoselenazole derivatives, with mechanistic controls and subsequent functional-group derivatizations.
decisions.challengeReason: The central result is a new preparative selenium-heterocycle construction route, not inorganic carbide characterization or biological activity. Derivative preparation and synthetic elaboration support method scope; publication is on JOC's inclusive activation date.

decisions.title: All the ways a cell can die — and why the variety matters
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched Nature title and feature-style metadata concern cell-death biology; no organic preparative claim appears in the record.
decisions.challengeReason: The subject is biological explanatory coverage rather than an original synthetic method. The exclusion follows the substantive topic and article context, not merely the absence of an abstract.

decisions.title: Hundreds of ‘free’ academic journals have started charging fees
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title is reporting on academic-journal publishing charges, with no chemical synthesis subject.
decisions.challengeReason: Neither a preparative reaction nor original organic chemistry is claimed; publishing-news coverage is out of scope.

decisions.title: Nepal floods pose biggest test yet for UN climate loss and damage fund
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title concerns flooding and climate-loss funding, not a chemical transformation.
decisions.challengeReason: Environmental-policy news is not a preparative organic-synthesis study; there is no ambiguous synthetic-method claim requiring a chemical-scope inference.

decisions.title: Watch scientists decipher burnt scrolls without unrolling them
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title describes deciphering historical scrolls without unrolling them, a non-synthetic science-reporting subject.
decisions.challengeReason: Potential imaging or analytical techniques do not turn this historical-document report into a preparative organic method. No synthesis contribution is claimed.

decisions.title: What happens in Vegas: one lecturer’s hunt for a projector
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title is a lecturer's projector-related anecdote, not an original chemical-method report.
decisions.challengeReason: A teaching/academic-life story has no preparative synthetic scope; no relevant organic transformation is suggested by the actual record.

decisions.title: Actionable genetic landscape and dynamics in circulating DNA from 12,827 patients with metastatic breast cancer
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract analyzes cell-free DNA samples, tumor mutations and therapy-related genomic patterns in a large metastatic-breast-cancer cohort; the publisher research listing corroborates this topic.
decisions.challengeReason: The work is clinical/genomic data analysis, not synthesis of DNA, drug molecules or a general organic method. Therapeutic relevance does not supply a preparative contribution.

decisions.title: Disentangling interaction and bias effects in opinion dynamics of large language models
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract develops a Bayesian analysis of opinion dynamics and biases in language-model discussions across non-chemical questions.
decisions.challengeReason: This is a computational/social-modeling study rather than even a chemistry-specific prediction method, and contains no preparative organic transformation.

decisions.title: Giant In-Plane Bulk Photovoltaic Response in γ-type Indium Selenide from Pressure-Induced Symmetry Breaking
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title and official research listing identify pressure-induced symmetry breaking and the photovoltaic response of indium selenide, an inorganic semiconductor.
decisions.challengeReason: The explicit contribution is a physical/electronic material property, not preparative organic or polymerization chemistry. This is an affirmative topic-based exclusion, not an inference from the empty compact abstract.

decisions.title: Long-range interdependencies aware signal analysis for rapid and accurate obstructive sleep apnea prediction
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title and official listing describe biomedical signal analysis for sleep-apnea prediction.
decisions.challengeReason: A diagnostic signal-analysis method is not a preparative chemical synthesis. The actual subject is unambiguously outside scope even though the compact abstract is empty.

decisions.title: Mortality and healthcare services in Pennsylvania state prisons following extreme ambient temperatures
decisions.evidenceBasis: The DOI-matched title and official listing concern temperature exposure, mortality and healthcare use in prisons.
decisions.challengeReason: The described public-health/epidemiology question does not claim chemical preparation or an organic transformation. No synthetic-scope ambiguity is present.

decisions.title: Direct C1-H Amination of Free NH Carbazoles Enabled by the Catellani Reaction
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports Pd/NBE-catalyzed direct C1-H amination of unprotected carbazoles, a broad range of cyclic amine partners and tolerance of several functional-group classes.
decisions.challengeReason: Pharmaceutical motivation is ancillary: the actual advance is a site-selective catalytic C-H amination with partner scope, rather than biological testing or a single target-specific synthesis.

decisions.title: Synthesis of α-Halophosphonates via Copper-Catalyzed Atom Transfer Radical Addition
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports copper-catalyzed atom-transfer radical addition to vinylphosphonates, spanning primary, secondary and tertiary haloalkanes and substituted alkene partners, with product derivatization.
decisions.challengeReason: The work develops a preparative reaction scope and product access, not merely Cu redox kinetics or properties of phosphorus compounds. Broad donor classes and synthetic elaborations confirm general method relevance.

decisions.title: Unified Copper-Catalyzed Stereoselective Addition: Construction of Vicinal F/CFx-Containing Stereocenters
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract describes asymmetric copper-catalyzed Michael addition producing vicinal F/CF3, F/CHF2 and F/CH2F stereocenters, with stereocontrol, scale-up and downstream functionalizations.
decisions.challengeReason: The mechanistic calculations support an experimentally demonstrated stereoselective synthetic method. Multiple fluorinated partner classes and preparative demonstrations rule out a purely theoretical or single-probe study.

decisions.title: Visible-Light-Catalyzed In Situ Generation of Nitrile Oxides from Aryl Trichloromethane and TBN for [3 + 2] Cycloaddition to Access Isoxazoline/Isoxazole Scaffolds
decisions.evidenceBasis: The abstract reports a visible-light three-component synthetic protocol using aryl trichloromethanes, unsaturated partners and tert-butyl nitrite for functionalized isoxazoline/isoxazole access, with functional-group compatibility and mechanistic controls.
decisions.challengeReason: Biological utility is only prospective. The central result is a preparative heterocycle-forming protocol with reaction scope; the proposed nitrile-oxide pathway is not mistaken for independently proven mechanistic fact.
